      "message": "My first choice is the Ninja Luxe Cafe Premier from listed merchant SharkNinja at $599.99 total. Its combination of integrated grinding, guided preparation and automatic milk steaming is particularly useful for a beginner making two morning milk drinks. You still handle the portafilter and tamping, but the assistance should make learning more approachable.\n\nTwo alternatives are worth considering individually:\n• Breville Barista Express Impress from Williams-Sonoma, $649.95: choose this for assisted tamping and a more hands-on espresso workflow with manual milk steaming. It offers room to develop your technique, though that requires practice.\n• De’Longhi Magnifica Evo with automatic milk frother from Best Buy, $749.99: choose this if automated bean-to-cup preparation matters enough to justify the extra $150 over the Ninja. The milk system still needs regular cleaning.\n\nBuy one machine. Based on general model knowledge, I expect each standard US package to provide suitable bean grinding, espresso brewing, milk steaming and the required accessories: portafilter, baskets, tamping equipment and milk pitcher, or built-in brewing components and a milk container. US electrical compatibility and standard package contents are assumptions, not independently verified listing details.
